name: ruflo
description: The original agent harness. Deploy intelligent multi-player swarms, coordinate autonomous workflows, and build conversational AI systems. Features adaptive memory, self-learning intelligence, federation, vector RAG integration, and native Claude Code / Codex / Hermes and many more Integrated
one_liner: A control layer that turns a single AI coding assistant into a coordinated team of specialized AI agents that remember past work and can talk to agents on other machines.
buyer: A startup CTO who wants one engineer's AI assistant to effectively act like a small team of AI developers on a big project.
business_use_cases: A small dev shop uses the swarm setup to parallelize feature work across specialized agents, shipping faster with the same headcount.
An enterprise platform team uses the federation feature to let AI agents on different machines or teams coordinate securely without centralizing sensitive data.
A freelance developer offers an 'AI dev team as a service' to clients, using Ruflo to orchestrate multiple agents on one project under a single contract.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid managed hosting (ruOS Desktop or cloud) and support for teams running agent swarms in production.

steal_this: Use it to run a side project with more 'hands' than you actually have, then sell the resulting speed as a freelance AI-augmented dev team service.
